scope: Source-CI Chromium orchestration of the existing synthetic hero against loopback Vite and real HTTP FastAPI/SQLite. Not AWS, model inference latency, human active time, time saved, or comparative quality.

sample_plan.order: Alternate new-payment then forwarded-duplicate for ordinal 1 through 10.
sample_plan.limit_boundary: Monotonic runner clock immediately before spawning Playwright through child-process exit; includes browser/server startup and all attempts, excludes dependency installation/build and post-run aggregation/artifact upload. Kill the process group at 900000 ms. Always retain the preallocated 20-slot journal, including unstarted and interrupted slots.
sample_plan.cold_warm: Fresh browser context/session each attempt; shared browser/server process. First ordinal is first-use, remaining ordinals reused-process; not proven AWS cold/warm starts. No warmup or discarded first attempt.

new-payment: Setup outside journey timer: empty synthetic session, home page ready, runtime and served-build identity checked.
Start timer immediately before the runner invokes Start reconciliation click; post editable sample JN-4410 invoice.
Review changed decision; run real scripted Strands; verify 1860 EUR draft; check review consent and retain original fingerprint.

Try new evidence; add the existing 600 EUR payment with transfer DEMO-BANK-600-A; verify before/after evidence, invalidated draft, cleared approval and no receipt. A diagnostic stale-fingerprint approval must return 409.
Prepare new 1260 EUR draft; require new fingerprint and fresh consent; approve exact content through SimulatedProvider; verify exactly one simulated provider-accepted receipt.

Prepare readable evidence in Workspace; verify new fingerprint and retained payment source, copy byte-equivalent text, download and verify identical UTF-8 bytes. Stop timer after complete downloaded bytes and assertions are available.
forwarded-duplicate: Setup outside journey timer: empty synthetic session, Records file chooser ready, runtime and served-build identity checked; read existing invoice/payment sample texts.
Start timer immediately before runner selects invoice.eml; preview then explicitly use/post invoice; preview then explicitly use/post payment.eml.
Run real scripted Strands; open forwarded duplicate of retained payment through guided link, preserving transfer reference; post it.
Verify collection held, graph disabled, original 600 EUR credit not doubled, no draft or receipt.
Resolve through explicit human-resolution controls linking email:003 to email:002 with a fixed note; reload durable state; verify 1260 EUR outstanding, original source intact and no receipt/draft.

Prepare readable evidence with duplicate-payment resolution and retained original source; download and verify identical UTF-8 bytes. Stop timer after complete downloaded bytes and assertions are available. No approval/send in this branch.

timing.clock: Node performance.now(), monotonic within the CI runner process; UTC timestamps are provenance only.
timing.journey: First specified action invocation to final verified evidence download bytes, including browser automation, assertions, simulated consent, diagnostic API reads/stale-approval negative control, HTTP work and browser rendering/waits. Excludes initial session/navigation/runtime checks and final journal serialization. Failure elapsed is observed/censored, never a completed journey.
timing.browser_http: Runner-observed Playwright request event to requestfinished/requestfailed event (response body transfer complete, not JSON parsing). Also record request-to-response event. Includes proxy/server/network/browser/event scheduling; not server-exclusive or model latency. Unknown/censored ends remain null.
timing.diagnostic_http: Runner API call invocation to full response JSON/body consumption; includes diagnostic parsing and automation overhead. Explicitly separated from browser HTTP rows.
timing.bytes: UTF-8 request/decoded response body bytes, excluding headers, TLS and wire compression. Null means unavailable, not zero.
timing.graph: The /api/reason HTTP rows are inclusive scripted Strands endpoint durations, not live model latency.
timing.percentile_estimator: Nearest rank: sort successful complete journey_ms; p50=x[ceil(0.50*n)-1], p95=x[ceil(0.95*n)-1]. No interpolation. Null for n=0. Report success-only n alongside fixed planned denominator 10 per branch/20 overall. Failed, timed-out, interrupted and unstarted slots remain in raw outcomes and failure counts, not successful latency samples.

environment.browser: Chromium supplied by existing pinned @playwright/test 1.63.0 and package-lock.json; record actual version
environment.versions: Record candidate Git SHA, preregistration ancestor SHA and protocol SHA256, application baseline SHA, exact source-build index/assets SHA256 checked against served loopback bytes, /api/health commit and modes, Node/Python/browser/OS versions and CI run URL. Require unchanged frontend/src and src relative to application baseline; backend health commit must equal candidate checkout SHA. These are source-build identities, not deployed AWS versions.
environment.safety: No external origins or live URL inputs, AWS credentials/state bucket, Bedrock/model keys, real mail or deployment. Require health live_model=false, live_send=false, LedgerScriptModel, SimulatedProvider and bounded-local-rules before any journey. Sessions and all inputs synthetic.

cost.model_invocations: 0 and model_cost_usd=0 only after the scripted runtime/source safety checks pass; otherwise null/unverified. Scripted Strands invocations are not paid model invocations.
cost.aws_infrastructure_cost_status: UNKNOWN_NOT_MEASURED: no AWS measurement; never infer zero from zero paid model calls.
cost.runner_cost_status: NOT_MEASURED; observed runner seconds, request counts and body byte counts are inputs, not billing.

evidence_policy.preregistration: Commit this JSON before instrument implementation; instrument pins that ancestor and exact JSON SHA256. Preserve ancestry at merge. No measurement before instrument source regression passes.
evidence_policy.raw: Initialize all 20 unique ordered slots before Playwright startup; persist at start, request completion, journey boundary and attempt completion. Preserve partial outcomes if instrument/server/global timeout fails. Retain immutable run-specific raw JSON, summary, protocol, build/version metadata and SHA256 manifest as CI artifacts for 90 days.
evidence_policy.fail_closed: Manual benchmark job fails unless all 20 unique planned attempts pass, expected runtime/build checks pass, evidence is complete and invocation stays within the fixed budget. A failed workflow still publishes all available evidence. No outcome-based threshold tuning, sample removal, retry, replacement, or automatic rerun. Any later corrected instrument/run must be explicitly identified and retain earlier failed artifacts.
evidence_policy.source_checks: Existing Vitest runner verifies plan, quantiles, failure/timeout/partial/setup-failure retention, safety gates and reporter accounting with synthetic already-spent fixtures; normal source CI still runs existing product tests. Benchmark is manual opt-in on existing frontend verification workflow, source-only with read-only repository permission. No AR2 corpus, harness or evaluation changes.
